title: Auth flow
description: Example assembly for the auth flow: sign-in → sign-up → forgot-password → reset-password → verify. It owns the navigation state the five screens refuse to hold — which step is on the route, the address carried between them, the reset token, the seconds left on the verify resend and the two confirmations a card paints once a recovery link or a fresh code has gone out — and it moves between them the way a client router does: the screens draw plain hrefs (hrefFor), the assembly intercepts the clicks it owns and leaves modified clicks and every other link to the browser, and each forward step is a form submission read with its submitter. Rewrite it against your own router; the screens under it stay presentational.
